title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Career Change Guide
summary: Start career change guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Audit your transferable skills and interests
2. Research 3-5 target roles deeply
3. Do 10+ informational interviews
4. Close skill gaps with courses or certs
5. Build 2-3 portfolio projects

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

Research 3-5 target roles deeply
Do 10+ informational interviews

title: Career Change Guide Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common career change guide questions.
body:
Q: Am I too old?
A: No - employers value experience; frame it as an asset.

Q: Should I take a pay cut?
A: Sometimes temporarily; research the target salary band first.

Q: Degree or certificate?
A: Certificates and portfolios beat second degrees for most pivots.
